# Satori

> Satori is a hospitality marketing agency for independent and boutique hotels, based in Toronto and New York. It runs the full marketing engine for owner-run hotels, inns and resorts: pricing and direct bookings, brand and positioning, website and booking path, social media and content, photography and film, and paid media and email. Every engagement starts with the hotel's margin: what booking platforms (OTAs) take each year and what the property could earn.

## Key facts

- Name: Satori (also "Satori for Hotels")
- Type: Hotel and hospitality marketing agency
- Founded: 2025
- Based in: Toronto, Ontario, Canada and New York, USA
- Serves: Independent and boutique hotels, inns and resorts in Canada, the United States and the Caribbean
- Ideal client: Independent, owner-run property with roughly 10 to 40 rooms and a strong sense of place
- Not a fit for: Hotel chains, management-company properties, discount-led strategies
- Founder: A principal who has spent her career in hospitality, working with the world's biggest travel and hotel brands on how they drive revenue
- Website: https://satori-destinations.com
- Email: hello@satori-destinations.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/satori_for_hotels/

## Services

- Revenue and direct bookings: rate strategy, rate parity, booking engine setup and a direct-booking advantage that reduces OTA commissions
- Brand and positioning: story, naming, voice and target guest
- Website and booking path: hotel websites designed to look like the property and convert on mobile
- Social media and content: planned, shot, written and posted on a regular rhythm
- Photography and film: editorial hotel photography and short films
- Paid media and email: paid strategy, remarketing and guest email

## How engagements work

1. Intro call: 20 minutes, tell us your story.
2. Satori Audit: CAD 3,500, a working session that ends in a plan and two numbers, what booking platforms take each year and what the property could earn. Credited to the first month of a retainer.
3. Monthly retainer: full-service marketing on a four-quarter rhythm, first results live by day 60.

A free 48-hour "leak check" is available for independent hotels: https://satori-destinations.com/leak-check/
